dispersion.what_the_pooling_bought: W25 alone: mean +40.16, mean/SE 0.90, and dropping seed 1633 collapsed it to +4.99 -- the SIGN of the effect rested on one seed. Pooled to 8: mean +32.25, mean/SE 1.48, and the WORST leave-one-out is +16.05 (still drop-1633). All 8 leave-one-out means are positive, range +16.05..+47.35. The reading no longer depends on any single seed. That, not the smaller point estimate, is what the second wave bought.

side_saturation_finding.what: Across all 347 scored games, dire won 317 (91.4%) and radiant 30 (8.6%) -- while radiant held MORE team gold in both strata (+15805 mean when armed-on-radiant, +7276 when armed-on-dire).
side_saturation_finding.winner_by: engine_natural 347/347 -- none of these are the analyze_log.py econ_winner rewrite, they are real ancient kills
side_saturation_finding.why_it_matters: 铁律 2(b) names WINS/LOSSES as the promote witness, and recover_verdict.py now computes it. But with the strata pinned at 0.109 and 0.963 the swap-and-average has almost no headroom left: an armed effect has to move a probability that is already within 4-11 points of a boundary. The pooled winrate 0.537 sits 1.43 SE off neutral -- the same order as gpm -- so it is not contradicting the economy read, but it is NOT the independent witness 2(b) reads as. Filed for the director.
side_saturation_finding.corroboration: The team-gold delta between strata is 15805-7276 = 8529 gold in favour of the armed leg, same sign as gpm +32.25 -- the economy read has a second, coarser witness even though the winrate does not.
